content: Written 2026-10-07 20:51. Real row 4 S3cb + RE = code da5476c, stage B from v7's A checkpoint (the final chain's A, 93.31): --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --render-evidence --dataset real --resume --sessions ab. C only after a B that passes.

Only the evidence extraction changes for the representation: in 3DGS the surface a pixel sees is the first-echo Gaussian of the render (the median depth the official readout fuses), not an element centre; per frame and element: pixels on the reading (|m - d| <= tol) vs passed (d - m > tol); the frame's verdict = the larger count (the fork's step-5 vote form, session_refusion.cpp:1269-1294: seen through = through > hit).

tol = the layer's existing sensor tolerance surface_match_tolerance 0.05 m (core/evidence.py:447); no element extent added (the median depth is the rendered surface, supervisor 20:55); no new estimator or constant.
